# TomoCPT options

<!-- Generated by `python -m tomocpt.configManager.option_docs --out docs/options.md` from
tomocpt/defaultConfigs/ and tomocpt/configManager/option_levels.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting of `tomocpt prepare_data` (section `prepData`), `tomocpt train` (`train`) and
`tomocpt predict` (`infer`), plus the paths in `shared`. What to change and when:
[tuning.md](tuning.md). Worked configs: [examples/](examples/).

**Setting an option.** In a YAML file given with `--config_file` (sections as below, sub-sections
nested), or on the command line as `key=value` after the flags, relative to the command's section
(`tomocpt train ... particles.class_head=softmax`). Only the **basic** options are also
`--flags`. Booleans are `true`/`false`; `none` clears an optional value.

**Levels.** `basic`: the everyday command-line flags and required values. `advanced`: every other
setting that changes training or prediction. `diagnostic`: settings that only add output for
inspection. `tomocpt init --level basic|advanced|diagnostic` writes a commented YAML with every
option up to that level. Settings left out of a YAML keep their defaults.

Required values are marked `???`. Fields that are not settings (unused, fixed by the code, or the
copies of the `shared` paths) are not listed.

## shared

Paths used by several commands; `training_data_dir` and `chunks_dir` are also the flags `--training_data_dir` / `--chunks_dir` of `prepare_data` and `train`.

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shared.training_data_dir` | basic | optional path | `none` | Path to where the volume label pairs should be stored |
| `shared.chunks_dir` | basic | optional path | `none` | The directory with chunks |

## prepData

`tomocpt prepare_data`.

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prepData.raw_data_dir` | basic (flag) | str | `???` (required) | Comma-separated paths to tomogram directories |
| `prepData.particle_length_ang` | basic (flag) | str | `???` (required) | Comma-separated list of particle lengths in angstroms |
| `prepData.coordinate_files` | basic (flag) | str | `???` (required) | Comma-separated paths to coordinate files |
| `prepData.coordinate_file_type` | basic (flag) | one of: star, imod | `star` | Coordinate file type (star or imod)? |
| `prepData.class_id` | basic (flag) | str | `all` | Comma-separated list of class IDs |
| `prepData.desired_particle_pixel_size` | advanced | int | `20` | Resize the volume so that the particle diameter is this many pixels |
| `prepData.apix_override` | basic (flag) | optional float | `none` | Voxel size in A to use instead of the MRC header value (all tomograms) |
| `prepData.label_border_policy` | advanced | one of: skip, clip | `skip` | Particles whose box touches the tomogram border: 'skip' (legacy, become negatives) or 'clip' (draw the in-bounds part) |
| `prepData.multiclass` | basic (flag) | bool | `false` | One dataset holds every species: STAR files with rlnClassNumber, diameters from class_diameters (pipeline v2) |
| `prepData.class_diameters` | basic (flag) | optional str | `none` | Multi-class diameters in A, per class number, e.g. '1:120,2:130' |
| `prepData.class_names` | basic (flag) | optional str | `none` | Multi-class names per class number, e.g. '1:apo-ferritin,2:ribosome' |
| `prepData.class_annotated` | advanced | optional str | `none` | Classes annotated exhaustively (numbers or names, comma-separated); default: every class present |
| `prepData.filament_masks` | advanced | optional str | `none` | Filament classes from segmentation masks: '&lt;class number&gt;:&lt;mask dir&gt;,...' (MRC masks matched to tomograms by name; diameter from class_diameters; pipeline v2) |
| `prepData.filament_coords` | basic (flag) | optional str | `none` | Filament classes from coordinates: '&lt;class number&gt;:&lt;coords dir&gt;,...' (per tomogram a RELION STAR with rlnHelicalTubeID or an IMOD model of open contours; spline-fitted) |
| `prepData.filament_smoothing_ang` | advanced | float | `10.0` | Spline smoothing of filament labels, as an RMS deviation in A |
| `prepData.filament_label_spacing_ang` | advanced | optional float | `none` | Spacing in A of the filament label points along the spline (default 0.5 x voxel size) |
| `prepData.write_filament_masks` | diagnostic | bool | `false` | Also write binary tube masks &lt;dataset_dir&gt;/filament_masks/&lt;class name&gt;/&lt;tomo&gt;.mrc (for inspection; never used as training targets) |
| `prepData.negative_masks` | advanced | optional str | `none` | Masks of structures that are never a class (e.g. membranes): '&lt;name&gt;:&lt;mask dir&gt;,...' (MRC masks matched to tomograms by name; negatives for the contrastive loss; pipeline v2) |
| `prepData.ALPHA_FOR_DROPPING_EMPTY_CUBES` | advanced | float | `1` | Chunk pipeline: an empty training chunk is dropped with probability clip(1 - alpha * f1/f0, 0, 1), f1/f0 = labelled / unlabelled voxels of the tomogram; larger alpha keeps more empty chunks |

## train

`tomocpt train`.

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.model_dir` | basic (flag) | path | `???` (required) | The directory where the training weights will be saved |
| `train.n_epochs` | basic (flag) | int | `10` | Number of epochs to train |
| `train.batch_size` | basic (flag) | int | `16` | batch size |
| `train.gradient_accumulation_steps` | advanced | int | `1` | Accumulate gradients over N steps |
| `train.use_gpus` | basic (flag) | bool | `true` | use cuda for training |
| `train.n_cpus_for_preprocessing` | advanced | int | `8` | Number of CPU workers for the initial chunking/preprocessing step. |
| `train.n_cpus_for_dataloading` | basic (flag) | int | `8` | Number of CPU workers per GPU for the PyTorch DataLoader during training. |
| `train.experiment_name` | basic (flag) | optional str | `tomocpt` | The name of the experiment |
| `train.mode` | basic (flag) | one of: selfSupervised, picking | `picking` | The training mode |
| `train.train_on` | advanced | one of: tomos, chunks | `tomos` | Whether to split train-val on chunks or tomograms |
| `train.resume_from` | basic (flag) | optional path | `none` | Path to a checkpoint to resume a previously interrupted training run. |
| `train.fine_tune_from` | basic (flag) | optional path | `none` | Path to a checkpoint to use as a starting point for fine-tuning or distillation. |
| `train.launch_tensorboard` | basic (flag) | bool | `false` | Launch tensorboard for evaluating training |
| `train.data_pipeline_version` | basic (flag) | int | `1` | Data pipeline: 1 = legacy fixed-particle rescale, 2 = band scale policy, multi-class |
| `train.chunk_sampling` | advanced | one of: uniform, repeat_factor | `uniform` | Training chunk sampling: 'uniform' (legacy) or 'repeat_factor' (pipeline v2 only) |
| `train.repeat_factor_threshold` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Threshold t of repeat-factor sampling: r_c = max(1, sqrt(t / f_c)) |
| `train.repeat_factor_max` | advanced | optional float | `none` | Upper limit of the per-class repeat factor r_c (chunk_sampling=repeat_factor); None = no cap |
| `train.sampling` | advanced | str | `auto` | Where training crops come from: 'auto' (on_the_fly for pipeline v2 picking unless chunks_dir already holds chunk files; chunks otherwise), 'chunks' (chunk files) or 'on_the_fly' (crops drawn from one array per tomogram, Gate 8c) |
| `train.cv_folds` | basic (flag) | int | `0` | k-fold training by tomogram (pipeline v2): number of folds; 0 = off (random split) |
| `train.cv_fold` | basic (flag) | int | `0` | k-fold training: the fold used for validation, in [0, cv_folds) |
| `train.val_stems` | advanced | optional str | `none` | Fixed validation split by tomogram (pipeline v2): comma-separated tomogram stems; None = random split. Cannot be combined with cv_folds |
| `train.early_stop_min_delta` | advanced | float | `0.005` | Early stopping on val_loss_smooth: minimum absolute improvement that counts (legacy 0.005) |
| `train.early_stop_patience` | advanced | int | `10` | Early stopping: epochs without improvement before training stops |
| `train.early_stop_rel_delta` | advanced | optional float | `none` | Relative improvement threshold in (0, 1): an epoch counts as progress only if val_loss_smooth &lt; best * (1 - value); replaces early_stop_min_delta and is used by lr_plateau_match_early_stop (None = absolute, legacy) |
| `train.lr_plateau_match_early_stop` | advanced | bool | `false` | ReduceLROnPlateau uses early stopping's improvement test (absolute early_stop_min_delta on val_loss_smooth) with patience lr_plateau_patience, so the LR halves before training stops (legacy: relative 1e-4, patience 9) |
| `train.lr_plateau_patience` | advanced | int | `5` | lr_plateau_match_early_stop: epochs without improvement before the LR halves (must be &lt; early_stop_patience) |
| `train.schedule_free` | advanced | bool | `false` | Schedule-free RAdam (schedulefree.RAdamScheduleFree, pip install 'tomocpt[schedulefree]'): no LR scheduler, no SWA; validation and checkpoints use the optimiser's averaged weights |
| `train.weight_averaging` | advanced | str | `swa` | Weight averaging: 'swa' (legacy Lightning SWA), 'ema' (EMA of the weights from step 0), 'swa_plateau' (SWA started when val_loss_smooth plateaus) or 'none'. EMA and plateau SWA validate and save the averaged weights |
| `train.ema_decay` | advanced | float | `0.999` | Maximum EMA decay (weight_averaging=ema) |
| `train.lr_scaling` | advanced | str | `none` | Scale lr with the effective batch: 'none', 'sqrt' (Adam-family rule) or 'linear' (SGD rule); EMA decay becomes decay**k |
| `train.lr_reference_batch` | advanced | int | `16` | Effective batch size at which lr was tuned (lr_scaling reference) |
| `train.lr_warmup_steps` | advanced | int | `0` | Linear LR warmup over the first N optimizer steps (every param group, after lr_scaling); 0 = off. Not with schedule_free |
| `train.snapshot_chunks` | diagnostic | int | `0` | Pipeline v2: chunks per class and split (train, val) predicted after every validation and saved as volumes in &lt;log_dir&gt;/snapshots for scripts/train_dashboard.py; 0 = off |
| `train.swa_plateau_patience` | advanced | int | `5` | weight_averaging=swa_plateau: validations without a relative improvement before averaging starts |
| `train.swa_plateau_rel_delta` | advanced | float | `0.001` | weight_averaging=swa_plateau: relative improvement of val_loss_smooth that counts |
| `train.cv_all_folds` | basic (flag) | bool | `false` | k-fold CV in one command (pipeline v2): train every fold of cv_folds, each in its own process, from one shared chunk pool; then build the fold ensemble with out-of-fold calibration and write the CV report to &lt;model_dir&gt;/&lt;experiment_name&gt; |
| `train.cv_class_weights` | diagnostic | optional str | `none` | CV report only: class weights of the mean F-beta, e.g. 'beta-amylase:0,thyroglobulin:2' (classes not named weigh 1) |
| `train.use_distillation` | advanced | bool | `false` | Enable knowledge distillation when fine-tuning from a checkpoint |
| `train.distill_weight` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Blend factor between task loss and teacher-guided distillation (0-1) |
| `train.feature_distill_weight` | advanced | float | `1.0` | Relative weight for feature matching inside the distillation loss |
| `train.temperature` | advanced | float | `2.0` | Softmax temperature applied to teacher/student logits during distillation |
| `train.OVERFIT_N_BATCHES` | advanced | optional int | `none` | Debugging: train and validate on this many batches only (Lightning overfit_batches); None = off |
| `train.N_CPUS_IF_NO_GPU` | advanced | int | `32` | CPU training (use_gpus=false or no GPU): number of CPU processes Lightning trains on |
| `train.FACTOR_REDUCE_LR_PLATEAU_N_EPOCHS` | advanced | float | `0.5` | ReduceLROnPlateau: factor the learning rate is multiplied by on a plateau of val_loss_smooth |
| `train.COSINE_LR_SCHEDULE_N_EPOCHS` | advanced | int | `6` | weight_averaging=swa: annealing epochs of Lightning's StochasticWeightAveraging |
| `train.PATIENT_REDUCE_LR_PLATEAU_N_EPOCHS` | advanced | int | `6` | Legacy ReduceLROnPlateau: patience is 1.5 x this many epochs and cooldown this // 4 (with lr_plateau_match_early_stop only the cooldown) |
| `train.CHUNK_STRIDE` | advanced | int | `32` | Stride of the chunk grid in voxels (overlap = CHUNK_SIZE - CHUNK_STRIDE); also sets the expected number of on-the-fly crops per epoch |
| `train.SEED_FOR_TRAIN_VAL_SPLIT` | advanced | int | `42` | Seed of the random train/validation split by tomogram (and of the k-fold assignment) |

The optimizer

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.optimizer.lr` | advanced | float | `0.0004` | Learning rate |
| `train.optimizer.weight_decay` | advanced | float | `1e-08` | Weight decay of the optimizer |
| `train.optimizer.betas` | advanced | 2 x float | `0.9,0.999` | Adam-family betas (momentum, second moment) |

### train.network

The network config

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.network.model_type` | advanced | one of: Unet, SwinUNETR | `SwinUNETR` | The model type |
| `train.network.CONTRAST_LOSS_L1_EMB_REGULARIZATION` | advanced | float | `0.0001` | Self-supervised v1: weight of the L1 penalty on the contrastive embeddings |
| `train.network.CONTRAST_LOSS_TEMPERATURE` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Self-supervised: temperature of the NT-Xent contrastive loss |
| `train.network.TORCH_MATMUL_PRECISION` | advanced | str | `medium` | torch.set_float32_matmul_precision: 'medium', 'high' or 'highest' (TF32 use on Ampere and newer GPUs) |

| `train.network.SELF_SUPERVISED_EMBEDING_SIZE` | advanced | int | `256` | Self-supervised: size of the global contrastive projection |
| `train.network.scale_conditioning` | advanced | bool | `false` | FiLM conditioning of the decoder on the working voxel size (SwinUNETR, pipeline v2) |

### train.augmentation

Training-time augmentation settings

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.augmentation.affine_p` | advanced | float | `0.8` | Probability of applying a random affine (image and label together) |
| `train.augmentation.affine_degrees` | advanced | float | `45.0` | Maximum random rotation in degrees for the affine transform |
| `train.augmentation.elastic_blur_p` | advanced | float | `0.75` | Probability of applying one of elastic deformation / blur |
| `train.augmentation.elastic_weight` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Relative weight of elastic deformation within the elastic/blur choice |
| `train.augmentation.blur_weight` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Relative weight of blur within the elastic/blur choice |
| `train.augmentation.blur_std` | advanced | float | `1.0` | Standard deviation of the random blur kernel |
| `train.augmentation.label_interpolation` | advanced | one of: nearest, linear | `nearest` | Interpolation of the target in the spatial transforms: 'nearest' (legacy) or 'linear' (smooth soft targets; recommended with pipeline v2). The target stays a LabelMap. |
| `train.augmentation.rotation_mode` | advanced | one of: affine, flips | `affine` | 'affine' (legacy random rotation + elastic/blur) or 'flips' (axis flips, no elastic deformation; keeps the real missing wedge in place) |
| `train.augmentation.flip_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Per-axis flip probability when rotation_mode='flips' (suggestion 0.5) |
| `train.augmentation.use_mw_aug` | advanced | bool | `false` | Enable missing-wedge augmentation (zeroes a wedge of Fourier coefficients) |
| `train.augmentation.use_fourier_aug` | advanced | bool | `false` | Enable amplitude-spectrum randomization (simulates varied CTF/defocus/dose filtering) |
| `train.augmentation.fourier_auto` | advanced | bool | `true` | Pipeline v2 picking: turn use_mw_aug and use_fourier_aug on (default). False keeps the two switches as set. No effect on pipeline v1 or self-supervised training |
| `train.augmentation.missing_wedge_prob` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Probability of applying the missing wedge |
| `train.augmentation.amplitude_prob` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Probability of applying amplitude-spectrum randomization |
| `train.augmentation.sample_kernel_prob` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Probability of localizing the degradation to a soft blob when the wedge did not fire. Whenever the wedge fires the blend is forced on regardless. |
| `train.augmentation.keep_angle_min` | advanced | float | `45.0` | Minimum half-opening angle in degrees of the RETAINED wedge: 90 keeps everything, 0 keeps nothing |
| `train.augmentation.keep_angle_max` | advanced | float | `45.0` | Maximum half-opening angle in degrees of the retained wedge |
| `train.augmentation.smooth_sigma_min` | advanced | float | `2.0` | Minimum Gaussian smoothing sigma for the synthesized amplitude spectrum |
| `train.augmentation.smooth_sigma_max` | advanced | float | `4.0` | Maximum Gaussian smoothing sigma for the synthesized amplitude spectrum |
| `train.augmentation.step_sigma_min` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Minimum random-walk step sigma for the synthesized amplitude spectrum |
| `train.augmentation.step_sigma_max` | advanced | float | `4.0` | Maximum random-walk step sigma for the synthesized amplitude spectrum |
| `train.augmentation.offset_min` | advanced | float | `2.0` | Minimum offset for the synthesized amplitude spectrum |
| `train.augmentation.offset_max` | advanced | float | `10.0` | Maximum offset for the synthesized amplitude spectrum |
| `train.augmentation.taper_width` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Raised-cosine taper width in degrees on the wedge boundary. 0 is the hard-edged reference behaviour, which causes Gibbs ringing a picking model can latch onto. |
| `train.augmentation.reclip` | advanced | bool | `true` | Re-apply the +/- clip_value hard clip after the Fourier degradation |
| `train.augmentation.clip_value` | advanced | float | `3.0` | Clip bound matching robust_normalization's hard clip |
| `train.augmentation.brightness_gradient_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of adding a localized Gaussian brightness blob |
| `train.augmentation.local_gamma_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of applying a gamma correction within a soft blob |
| `train.augmentation.brightness_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of a global Gaussian brightness shift |
| `train.augmentation.brightness_sigma` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Standard deviation of the global brightness shift |
| `train.augmentation.contrast_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of scaling contrast about the image mean |
| `train.augmentation.contrast_min` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Minimum multiplicative contrast factor |
| `train.augmentation.contrast_max` | advanced | float | `2.0` | Maximum multiplicative contrast factor |
| `train.augmentation.contrast_preserve_range` | advanced | bool | `false` | Clamp the contrast result back into the input's original range |
| `train.augmentation.anisotropy_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of tio.RandomAnisotropy (stands in for SimulateLowResolution) |
| `train.augmentation.noise_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of tio.RandomNoise (additive Gaussian noise) |
| `train.augmentation.noise_std` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Maximum standard deviation for tio.RandomNoise |
| `train.augmentation.gamma_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of tio.RandomGamma (global gamma) |
| `train.augmentation.bias_field_p` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Probability of tio.RandomBiasField, a smooth MULTIPLICATIVE field. Complementary to the additive brightness gradient, not redundant with it. |

### train.scale

Scale policy of data pipeline v2

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.scale.band_min_vox` | advanced | float | `10.0` | Lower edge of the band of class diameters, in working voxels (pipeline v2) |
| `train.scale.band_max_vox` | advanced | float | `32.0` | Upper edge of the band of class diameters, in working voxels (pipeline v2) |
| `train.scale.scales_per_level` | advanced | int | `1` | Working voxel sizes per level: 1 = the level's size only; k &gt; 1 adds k-1 jittered sizes |
| `train.scale.resample` | advanced | one of: trilinear, fourier | `fourier` | Resampling method of pipeline v2 (fourier = Fourier cropping, anti-aliased) |
| `train.scale.zoom_aug_max` | advanced | float | `1.0` | Maximum zoom factor of the zoom augmentation (1.0 = off; suggestion 1.25) |

### train.particles

Multi-class picking settings (pipeline v2)

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.particles.class_weights` | advanced | optional str | `none` | Per-class loss weights by class number, e.g. '1:1.0,2:2.0' (missing classes weigh 1.0) |
| `train.particles.loss_checkpoint` | advanced | bool | `false` | Gradient checkpointing in the Hessian loss term (saves memory, slower) |
| `train.particles.cross_class_neg_weight` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Extra negative weight (x positive weight) for voxels inside another class's particle; 0 = off |
| `train.particles.class_head` | advanced | str | `sigmoid` | Class head of pipeline-v2 pickers: 'sigmoid' (independent classes) or 'softmax' (classes and an implicit background compete per voxel) |
| `train.particles.softmax_scope` | advanced | str | `all` | Softmax head only (Gate 3e): 'all' (every channel in one softmax) or 'particles' (softmax over particle channels, filament channels independent sigmoids) |
| `train.particles.core_weight` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Centroid weight (Gate 4f): particle-channel value weight x (1 + core_weight * y^core_power), so the few core voxels of the target count; 0 = off |
| `train.particles.core_power` | advanced | float | `4.0` | Exponent p of the centroid weight |
| `train.particles.offset_weight` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Offset head (Gate 4f): weight of the L1 loss on the predicted sub-voxel offset to the particle centre; 0 = no head |

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.otf.volume_dtype` | advanced | str | `float16` | dtype of the stored tomograms: 'float16' or 'float32' (targets are always float32) |
| `train.otf.device` | advanced | str | `auto` | Where tomograms live for the GPU data path: 'auto', 'cuda' or 'cpu' |
| `train.otf.augment_device` | advanced | str | `auto` | Where augmentation runs: 'auto' (cuda when training on a GPU and every enabled augmentation has a GPU port, else cpu), 'cpu' (TorchIO in workers) or 'cuda' |
| `train.otf.samples_per_epoch` | advanced | optional int | `none` | Training crops per epoch; None = expected number of grid chunks |
| `train.otf.jitter` | advanced | bool | `true` | Uniform sub-stride jitter of the crop corners |
| `train.otf.negative_mask_weight` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Extra sampling weight of crops with negative-mask voxels (0 = off) |
| `train.otf.seed` | advanced | int | `42` | Seed of the training crop draws (with the epoch and the rank) |
| `train.otf.val_seed` | advanced | int | `1234` | Seed of the fixed validation crop set |
| `train.otf.val_samples` | advanced | optional int | `none` | Validation crops; None = expected number of grid chunks |

### train.ssl

Self-supervised pretraining settings (mode=selfSupervised)

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.ssl.version` | advanced | int | `1` | Self-supervised pretraining: 1 = legacy, 2 = wedge- and scale-aware |
| `train.ssl.use_rotation` | advanced | optional bool | `none` | 4-way rotation task (None: True for v1, False for v2; v2 forbids it) |
| `train.ssl.contrast_weight` | advanced | float | `1.0` | v2: weight of the global contrastive loss (0 = off) |
| `train.ssl.dense_weight` | advanced | float | `1.0` | v2: weight of the dense contrastive loss (0 = off) |
| `train.ssl.dense_dim` | advanced | int | `64` | v2: dense embedding size |
| `train.ssl.dense_grad_scale` | advanced | float | `0.0` | v2: scale of the dense contrastive gradient into the network (0 = head only, 1 = full) |
| `train.ssl.n_anchors` | advanced | int | `256` | v2: anchor points per sample for the dense contrastive loss |
| `train.ssl.recon_weight` | advanced | float | `10.0` | v2: weight of the masked reconstruction loss |
| `train.ssl.recon_visible_weight` | advanced | optional float | `none` | Weight of the L1 on visible voxels (None: 1.0 for v1, 0.1 for v2) |
| `train.ssl.scale_weight` | advanced | float | `1.0` | v2: weight of the relative-scale loss (0 = off) |
| `train.ssl.scale_range_log2` | advanced | float | `1.0` | v2: view scale factors are log-uniform in [1, 2^this] |
| `train.ssl.apix_ref_min` | advanced | float | `8.0` | v2: lower clip of the SSL reference voxel size (A) |
| `train.ssl.apix_ref_max` | advanced | float | `16.0` | v2: upper clip of the SSL reference voxel size (A) |
| `train.ssl.source_chunk` | advanced | int | `128` | v2: size of the SSL source chunks (stride = half of it) |
| `train.ssl.use_mw_aug` | advanced | bool | `true` | v2: missing wedge in the degradation D |
| `train.ssl.use_fourier_aug` | advanced | bool | `true` | v2: amplitude-spectrum randomisation in D |
| `train.ssl.degradation_p` | advanced | float | `0.8` | v2: probability of each Fourier degradation in D |
| `train.ssl.keep_angle_min` | advanced | float | `30.0` | v2: minimum kept wedge half-angle (deg) in D |
| `train.ssl.keep_angle_max` | advanced | float | `60.0` | v2: maximum kept wedge half-angle (deg) in D |
| `train.ssl.inversion_p` | advanced | float | `0.5` | v2: probability of contrast inversion of a view and its target |

### train.discriminative

Discriminative training of v2 pickers: contrastive loss, focal value term (Gate 7)

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train.discriminative.contrastive_weight` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Weight of the supervised dense contrastive loss (0 = off, no head created) |
| `train.discriminative.embed_dim` | advanced | int | `64` | Size of the contrastive embedding |
| `train.discriminative.temperature` | advanced | float | `0.1` | Temperature of the contrastive loss |
| `train.discriminative.anchors_per_class` | advanced | int | `32` | Maximum anchors per class per batch |
| `train.discriminative.anchor_min_target` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Minimum target value of an anchor (peak voxel of a particle / filament ridge) |
| `train.discriminative.bank_size` | advanced | int | `1024` | Memory bank size per class (and for negatives) |
| `train.discriminative.contrastive_warmup_steps` | advanced | int | `0` | The contrastive weight ramps linearly from 0 to contrastive_weight over the first N optimizer steps (0 = constant weight) |
| `train.discriminative.bank_max_age` | advanced | int | `0` | Memory-bank entries older than this many steps are not used (0 = no limit) |
| `train.discriminative.hard_negatives` | advanced | int | `64` | Hard negatives per batch, ranked by the model's score |
| `train.discriminative.hard_negative_min_score` | advanced | float | `0.3` | Lowest score of a hard negative |
| `train.discriminative.hard_negative_max_score` | advanced | float | `0.9` | Highest score of a hard negative (near-certain picks are often unlabelled particles) |
| `train.discriminative.exclusion_radius` | advanced | float | `1.0` | No negatives within this many class radii of a labelled object |
| `train.discriminative.mask_negatives` | advanced | int | `64` | Negatives per batch from prepData.negative_masks |
| `train.discriminative.init_from_ssl` | advanced | bool | `true` | Copy an SSL v2 checkpoint's dense head into the contrastive head when fine-tuning |
| `train.discriminative.value_loss` | advanced | str | `huber` | Value term of the v2 picking loss: 'huber' (Gate 6) or 'focal' (soft-target focal penalty with the Huber weights on particle channels; filament channels keep Huber) |
| `train.discriminative.focal_alpha` | advanced | float | `2.0` | Exponent gamma of \|y - p\| in the soft focal penalty |
| `train.discriminative.focal_beta` | advanced | float | `4.0` | Unused (beta of the CenterNet focal loss, kept for config compatibility) |
| `train.discriminative.embed_ce_weight` | advanced | float | `0.0` | Weight of the cosine-softmax cross-entropy on the projection embedding at the contrastive anchors, over the particle classes and background (0 = off) |
| `train.discriminative.prototype_head` | advanced | bool | `false` | Particle logits get a residual alpha * s * (cos(e, p_k) - cos(e, p_bg)) from the projection embedding (alpha learned, starts at 0) |
| `train.discriminative.prototype_scale` | advanced | float | `10.0` | Scale s of the cosine prototype logits (embedding CE and prototype head) |

## infer

`tomocpt predict`.

| Option | Level | Type | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `infer.tomogram_dir` | basic (flag) | optional path | `none` | Directory containing tomograms to process. |
| `infer.tomogram_file` | basic (flag) | optional path | `none` | Path to a single tomogram file. |
| `infer.predictions_dir` | basic (flag) | path | `???` (required) | Directory to save prediction outputs. |
| `infer.weights` | basic (flag) | optional path | `none` | Path to the trained model weights file (.ckpt). Required unless --skip_inference is used. |
| `infer.masks_dir` | advanced | optional path | `none` | Optional directory with masks for targeted picking. Mask filenames must match tomogram filenames. |
| `infer.length` | basic (flag) | optional float | `none` | Particle diameter in Angstroms. Required for pipeline-v1 checkpoints; not used for pipeline-v2 checkpoints (the class table gives the diameters). |
| `infer.distance_threshold` | advanced | optional float | `none` | Minimum distance between picked particles in Angstroms. Defaults to the particle diameter (pipeline v1) or peak_spacing_fraction x the class diameter (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.peak_spacing_fraction` | advanced | float | `0.5` | Pipeline v2: minimum distance between two picks of one class, as a fraction of the class diameter (0.5 = one radius, so touching particles stay apart). Ignored when distance_threshold is set. |
| `infer.confidence_threshold` | basic (flag) | float | `0.3` | Minimum confidence score for a voxel to be considered as a potential particle center. |
| `infer.predictions_coord_filename` | advanced | str | `tomocpt_coords.star` | Filename for the output coordinate star file. (Not used for imod format). |
| `infer.predictions_coord_format` | basic (flag) | one of: warp, relion_31, relion_50, imod | `relion_31` | Format for the output coordinate file. |
| `infer.predictions_batch_size` | basic (flag) | int | `2` | Internal batch size for model inference on tomogram patches. |
| `infer.save_predicted_coords` | advanced | bool | `true` | Enable/disable saving of predicted particle coordinates. |
| `infer.save_prediction_confidence_map` | advanced | bool | `false` | Save the full 3D prediction confidence map as an MRC file. |
| `infer.skip_inference` | basic (flag) | bool | `false` | Skip the inference step and extract peaks from confidence maps already present in `predictions_dir`. |
| `infer.use_cuda` | advanced | bool | `true` | Enable/disable CUDA for GPU acceleration. |
| `infer.use_tta` | basic (flag) | bool | `false` | Use test-time augmentation for prediction. This might improve picking, but at the cost of time anf GPU memory. |
| `infer.invert_contrast` | advanced | bool | `false` | Invert tomogram contrast (signal becomes black). |
| `infer.cpus_per_worker` | advanced | int | `2` | Number of CPU threads to support each Dask worker (for I/O, etc.). |
| `infer.apix_override` | basic (flag) | optional float | `none` | Voxel size in Angstroms to use instead of the MRC header value (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.classes` | basic (flag) | optional str | `none` | Comma-separated class names to pick (pipeline v2). Default: every class of the model. |
| `infer.cross_class_nms` | advanced | bool | `false` | Suppress peaks of different classes closer than half the smaller radius, keeping the higher score (pipeline v2). Off by default: softmax-head models already make the classes compete; turn it on for sigmoid-head models. |
| `infer.accumulate_dtype` | advanced | str | `float32` | dtype of the per-class map accumulators: float32 or float16 (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.accumulate_device` | advanced | str | `auto` | Device of the per-class map accumulators: auto (GPU if the maps fit in free memory), cuda or cpu (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.class_thresholds` | basic (flag) | optional str | `none` | Per-class confidence thresholds by class name, e.g. 'ribosome:0.4,proteasome:0.35'. Overrides the checkpoint calibration (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.calibration_beta` | advanced | float | `4.0` | Beta of the F-beta score maximised by the per-class threshold calibration (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.calibration_min_particles` | advanced | int | `20` | Minimum number of true particles of a class for its threshold to be calibrated (pipeline v2). |
| `infer.filament_calibration_beta` | advanced | float | `1.0` | Beta of the length-weighted centreline F-beta maximised by the tracing threshold calibration (filament classes). |
| `infer.filament_spacing_ang` | advanced | float | `40.0` | Spacing in A of the output points along each traced filament (filament classes). |
| `infer.filament_min_length_ang` | advanced | float | `200.0` | Traced filaments shorter than this many A are dropped (filament classes). |
| `infer.filament_smoothing_ang` | advanced | float | `10.0` | Spline smoothing of traced filaments, as an RMS deviation in A (filament classes). |
| `infer.subvoxel_refine` | advanced | str | `fit` | Pipeline v2 particle picks: 'fit' (log-quadratic fit around each peak, the legacy refinement) or 'offset' (the rounded peak plus the model's offset head prediction). |
| `infer.PATCH_OVERLAP_FACTOR` | advanced | int | `4` | Prediction patches overlap by patch_size // this (64 // 4 = 16 voxels); smaller values overlap more (slower, smoother maps) |
